vision.destination: A usable modular local Product/UI plus separately owned AI/media implementation, proven by actual construction, inference, browser and restart.
users: Human owner inspecting direction and evidence

Inherited framework acceptance as product acceptance

retrospectives.problem: The native full regression began before desktop responsive review, requiring an additional broad run after UI repairs.
retrospectives.hypothesis: Completing cheap source-catalogue checks and browser breakpoint/role review before the broad freeze reduces repeated expensive checks.
retrospectives.action: Use source validation, installed smoke checks and real UI/role review before the final frozen broad regression. Keep all failed/blocked attempts.
retrospectives.measure: This UX increment froze source after actual browser review; one required broad regression ran after freeze. Retain the practice; no statistical sigma estimate is claimed.

retrospectives.problem: The prior local workflow passed functional checks but the user found its developer-demo presentation mediocre. Source review also found selection, focus, warning and accessibility defects.
retrospectives.hypothesis: Designing and inspecting the reviewer task before qualification exposes usability defects that backend and screenshot-overflow checks miss.
retrospectives.action: Applied the experience rubric and independent interaction review before broad regression. Browser-tested media/review flow, stable selection, source warning and narrow geometry. Obtain real user feedback; no satisfaction score is invented.
retrospectives.measure: Observe core journey completion, stable keyboard selection, review feedback and zero overflow at the specified viewports. No user-satisfaction or world-class certification is claimed.
